known_evidence_before_freeze.V11_0: Transformation-only event model reduced downside but failed precision/lift.
known_evidence_before_freeze.V11_1: 70% V10.2 / 30% meta retained 94.1% of control precision, slightly improved lift, improved hit-fold rate and drawdown, and improved recent precision.

objective: Discover transformation stories before price momentum makes them obvious.
architecture: Transformation meta-model excludes V10.2 p100 and technical probability from its input matrix.
Transformation/meta evidence receives 60% of final ranking; V10.2 receives 40% as confirmation.
Every main-list stock must pass a transformation gate; pure V10.2 momentum cannot backfill the list.
Transformation gate can be passed by strong catalyst evidence, business inflection plus catalyst evidence, or promoter conviction plus persistent accumulation.
Already-priced-in penalty must remain below the frozen maximum.
V10.2 confirmation has only a low minimum percentile so early stories can enter before strong momentum appears.
Top-10 is a maximum, not a quota.
Evaluation includes precision/lift/drawdown plus early-stage and priced-in diagnostics.
methodology_note: V11.2 is model development after V11.0/V11.1 research. Historical backtests are research evidence; prospective shadow validation remains mandatory before replacement.
